gates.label: Station and dataset identity
gates.evidence: USGS official catalogues, source receipt hashes and published operator crosswalk
gates.decision: Use the named measurement support; do not claim parcel delivery or ownership

gates.label: Untouched prediction and alert performance
gates.evidence: Frozen North 2023–2024 evaluation: 1,014 evaluable windows; 6.84% lower mean absolute log1p error. The paired error-gain 95% interval is [0.001650, 0.017389]. Improvement is positive in both years. Historical corrected archives do not establish live as-issued performance.
gates.decision: Use as bounded North prediction evidence. Better monitoring allocation and transfer require separate evidence.

gates.label: Monitoring allocation and cost trade-off
gates.evidence: North selected model: 46 proposed slots, comprising 25 known high windows, 19 known non-high windows and 2 unknown outcomes. Baseline: 38 slots, comprising 26 high and 12 non-high windows. Different true-alert sets have different observed peak-time leads; a paired lead improvement is not established.
gates.decision: Do not promote either learned policy as commercially superior. The supplementary Glenwood classifier identified 8 high windows using 10 proposed slots versus 6 using 8 baseline slots; its joint no-more-spend and precision-superiority gate failed.

gates.label: Untouched decision-objective validation
gates.evidence: Glenwood 2024–2025: 1,510 evaluable windows, 20 high windows above the frozen 126 FNU threshold. Classifier: 10 slots, 8 high, 2 non-high. Baseline: 8 slots, 6 high, 2 non-high. No accepted outcome is unknown. Precision gain 5 percentage points; paired 95% interval [0, 13.33] percentage points.
gates.decision: The classifier fails the no-more-spend criterion and strict positive precision-interval criterion. Preserve the baseline and classifier as historical comparisons; prospective deployment needs a separately accepted policy.

gates.label: Portability to another watershed
gates.evidence: The North-trained state model increased East log1p error by 0.014971 across 1,481 windows. The paired gain 95% interval is [−0.026820, −0.003974].
gates.decision: Require local validation before cross-watershed deployment.

gates.label: Live data availability and service reliability
gates.evidence: Historical approved archives and a declared 30-minute release-latency assumption; observed release timing is unavailable.
gates.decision: A live service-level promise needs release-time telemetry and monitored operation

gates.label: Sampling access and laboratory verification
gates.evidence: No operator sampling permission, chain of custody or new paired suspended-sediment concentration sample is supplied.
gates.decision: Forecast flags cannot substitute for actual sample collection/results

gates.label: Additional environmental effect
gates.evidence: No causal intervention estimate, verified source-to-receptor effect or local treatment response
gates.decision: No credit issuance, avoided-loss estimate or performance-based payment derived

gates.label: Land, water and action rights
gates.evidence: Public monitoring stations and basin polygons do not establish rights
gates.decision: No automatic action or financing approval

gates.label: Buyer, operating threshold and cash costs
gates.evidence: No contracted buyer, actual laboratory quote, treatment operating curve or loss data
gates.decision: Input-based monitoring spend only; ROI and savings remain null

gates.label: Financing allocation and independent review
gates.evidence: No issuance framework, use-of-proceeds ledger, funds transfer or independent financial assurance
gates.decision: Export evidence for review, not approve a loan, bond, credit or payout

reference_frameworks.document: Water utilities and services additional sector guidance, June 2025
reference_frameworks.use: Supports contextual water targets and sector disclosure; this desk is not TNFD certification or a complete LEAP assessment
Project evaluation, proceeds tracking and impact reporting require evidence; this desk provides a monitoring evidence input, not a bond eligibility opinion

source_reuse: NorthernWater public automated retrieval permission does not imply unrestricted raw redistribution. Public release includes derived QA and source links, not its native bulk observations. USGS forecast evidence retains attribution.
interpretation: The desk produces traceable historical monitoring proposals and investment evidence records. North point accuracy improved modestly, its monitoring policy did not demonstrate superiority, and East transfer failed. The separate Glenwood classifier identified more high windows with more proposed slots, but failed its frozen joint business criteria. Sales demand, treatment benefits, a live operational service level and financial returns remain unvalidated.

supplementary_case.role: Separate Colorado River monitoring case; not a paired control or verified beneficiary
